b0d8dca3e2cdab2e.summary: Physicists uncover 'gravitational reconnection' hidden in Einstein's equations: curved spacetime field lines can snap and release massive energy flares. Hook: '100 years after Einstein, physicists just found a secret hidden in his equations: gravity can break and reconnect.'
b0d8dca3e2cdab2e.notes:
- Columbia University and Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez theoretical physicists discover 'gravitational reconnection'
- Analogous to magnetic reconnection on the Sun, extreme gravitational field lines in curved spacetime can snap and reconnect
- Operates near spinning Kerr black hole ergospheres and colliding binary neutron star mergers
- Solves longstanding astrophysical mystery of ultra-high-energy cosmic rays and relativistic plasma jets
- Validates deeper non-linear solutions within General Relativity without requiring new physics
